narrative.text: Both the annual report and management concalls reflect a shared emphasis on expanding manufacturing capabilities, home decor services, and retail presence [0.8, 0.9, 1.3, 1.4, 2.2, 3.6]. Management calls focus more directly on short-term operational execution, such as driving high single-digit volume growth, scaling new product contributions to 16-17% of revenue, and adding retail touchpoints [1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4]. The emphasis on calls also shifts toward managing margin volatility through price increases to offset input cost inflation and addressing seasonal factors like monsoons [1.10, 1.17, 2.4, 2.12, 4.13], whereas the annual report concentrates on governance, long-term investments, and risk management frameworks [0.8, 0.10, 0.17, 0.37].
